verdict.rationale: RUN documents online payroll reports that can be viewed, customized and printed, plus multi-company reports and analytics, so payroll reporting itself is first-party. The only documented export is of journal entries to QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file, which is accounting output rather than the reports themselves. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register and gross-to-net report types, documented export of reports (e.g. CSV/Excel) for analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.
